attempts.span: Calling external contracts can transfer control before your function finishes, allowing another contract to execute first.
attempts.proposition: Calling external contracts can transfer control before your function finishes, allowing another contract to execute first.
attempts.sentence: Calling external contracts can transfer control before your function finishes, allowing another contract to execute first.

attempts.span: This allows a malicious contract to call back into you before the original invocation completes.
attempts.proposition: This allows a malicious contract to call back into you before the original invocation completes.

attempts.span: Different invocations of the same function may then interact in undesirable ways.
attempts.proposition: Different invocations of the same function may then interact in undesirable ways.
attempts.sentence: Different invocations of the same function may then interact in undesirable ways.

attempts.span: To avoid this, perform all internal state changes before making any external calls.
attempts.proposition: To avoid this, perform all internal state changes before making any external calls.
attempts.sentence: To avoid this, perform all internal state changes before making any external calls.

attempts.span: This approach is known as the Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern.
